about: The author's own SOPHIE 1.1.13 package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, from soejrd/digisophie at ce17b9e (its OS 1.54 port). The OS 1.53 package stays in elekloader's catalog.

mods.title: SOPHIE
mods.summary: A metallic percussion machine with four models: FUSE, BOOM, PIPE and SHARD.
mods.description: Two-operator metallic percussion adaptation of Sophie with four distinct models. Its audio enters the normal Digitakt AMP, filter, mixer and sends; the source filter and drive are intentionally not ported.
mods.author: digisophie contributors
mods.on_unit: The OS 1.54 port (irpina, merged by the author at ce17b9e) builds the same SOPHIE 1.1.13 for 1.54. Not tested on a unit for 1.54 yet; the author tested 1.1.13 on OS 1.53: one track runs without FAST AUDIO, two ran with it on; eight tracks are not claimed.
